first_error.why: The investigation matter was in its 59-matter strict scan at [22], and the metadata script at [47] showed it staffed by the practice group, but the agent listed and read only four other matters and never opened its documents.

divergence: All three runs failed the same way: store-wide scans surfaced both needed matters, but each run shortlisted the dedicated executive-employment matters by practice labels and read those, so the first error in all three is surfaced-not-opened at the first listing or screening stage (T0 still found and included the settlement matter later through a litigation check). All three counted draft executive negotiations as qualifying. Reviews flagged hand-picked sets in every run and named a needed matter in T0 and T1, but the agents kept their shortlists; the agent-declared stages were scans, metadata checks and spot-checks, all matching existing stages.
